summary.text: Seth Rose is a Democratic state representative from Richland County who has represented South Carolina House District 72 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney and former Richland County councilman, Rose serves on the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rose earned a B.A. from the University of South Carolina in 2003 and a J.D. from the university in 2007, and he was a First Team All-America singles tennis player there.
The university inducted him into its Athletic Hall of Fame in 2014.
He joined the South Carolina Bar in 2007 and served as a Richland County assistant prosecutor from 2007 to 2011.
Rose served on Richland County Council from 2011 to 2018.
He took office in the House on November 12, 2018, succeeding James Smith Jr.
The Democratic primary was canceled, and Rose faces Republican Dixie Kvatek in the November 3 general election.
